display.purpose: Page titles and strongest prose entry points.

body.purpose: Long-form technical explanation within a 72ch measure.

motion.name: functional-fast
motion.purpose: Color, opacity, focus, and compact disclosure transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Touch-safe primary action that becomes compact at the desktop workbench breakpoint.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-button-primary { height: 32px; } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Touch-safe secondary action defined by structure rather than fill.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-button-outline { height: 32px; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Touch-safe repository and command input with compact desktop density and explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 12px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-input { height: 32px; } }

components.name: Documentation Navigation
components.description: Compact route list with an accent-toned active location.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 220px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar); font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { padding: 6px 8px; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--sidebar-ring); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-nav a.is-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Touch-safe primary routes that collapse to compact workbench density on desktop.
components.html: HomeBuilderDocumentation
components.css: .ds-header-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; font: 500 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-header-nav a { display: inline-flex; height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-header-nav a:hover, .ds-header-nav a.is-active { background: var(--muted); } .ds-header-nav a:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-header-nav a { padding-inline: 10px; } } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-header-nav a { height: 36px; } }

components.name: Selection Field
components.description: A reusable field-row state for module and relationship selection without leaking tree layout into the primitive.
components.css: .ds-selection-field { display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--foreground); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-selection-field:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 40%, transparent); } .ds-selection-field.is-selected { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 25%, transparent); } .ds-selection-field input { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: var(--primary); } .ds-selection-field span { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; } .ds-selection-field strong { font: 500 14px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-selection-field small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-selection-field:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Flat bordered code surface for commands and source examples.
components.css: .ds-code { overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--code-block-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--code-block); color: var(--code-block-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Table of Contents Item
components.description: Muted document location that becomes spectral teal when active.
components.html: Start a projectGrow incrementally
components.css: .ds-toc { display: grid; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-toc a { padding: 4px 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-toc a:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-toc a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toc a.is-active { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: The Stack Effect documentation is a quiet technical workspace. It uses monospaced headings, precision-neutral surfaces, fine structural borders, and a sparse spectral-teal signal that connects the docs to the CLI. The system is refined and tool-like without becoming a systems console.
keyCharacteristics: Code-forward hierarchy with monospaced headings and terminal content.
Precision Mono, low-chroma neutral surfaces in both themes.
Flat tonal layering reinforced by fine borders.
One spectral-teal accent for links, focus, selection, and active location.
Restrained, functional transitions and documentation-first density.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Spectral teal identifies the next meaningful action or the current location; it is not a decorative fill for large regions.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace carries structure and executable material; sans-serif carries explanation and operational labels.

rules.name: The Workbench Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated primarily by tone and structural rules. Shadows are a light-mode exception, never a default layer.

dos: Do keep prose centered within the 72ch reading measure.
Do use Spectral Signal for navigation, focus, selection, and meaningful actions.
Do use fine borders and tonal contrast to organize technical material.
Do preserve clear light- and dark-mode semantic relationships.
Do keep motion brief, functional, and respectful of reduced-motion needs.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a dense operational dashboard.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, glass effects, or nested card grids.
Don't use semantic status colors as competing brand accents.
Don't tint general surfaces teal or turn the signal into decoration.
Don't sacrifice body readability for an all-monospace interface.
